# SpriteAnimationFrame

[Toolkit](README.md) · `DotGame.Toolkit.Animation` · record struct

```csharp
public readonly record struct SpriteAnimationFrame(TextureRegion Region, float Hold = 1)
```

Types: [`TextureRegion`](TextureRegion.md)

One frame of a [`SpriteAnimation`](SpriteAnimation.md).

## Properties

### Hold

```csharp
public float Hold { get; init; }
```

How many frames' worth of time the frame shows for, relative to the animation's frame rate: 1 is one frame, 3 holds it three times as long, and 0.5 shows it for half a frame. Must be positive.
